rank_rule: ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); kth order statistic; infinity if k>n
rule_grouping: triggered: pool nodes and horizons; untriggered: per node, pool horizons
rule_source: frozen SG-DATA-006 three-component behavior rule fitted on tuning, never target_event
interval: y_pred +/- q; preserve negative lower endpoints and archived predictions

bootstrap.group_by: America/Los_Angeles origin issue date; consecutive nonoverlapping seven-day blocks; all nodes/horizons/seeds retained

scope: exploratory frozen-prediction supplement; previously inspected retrospective test; no model training or tuning on test
